race.title: Dudley Peverill Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: SERAPHIC is now going the right way for his current yard and remains well treated on his form in France, so he's fancied to complete the hat-trick. Mariole is entitled to come on for his recent comeback run at Worcester and is second choice. SERAPHIC (IRE) MARIOLE (FR) MISTER DES PLACES (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Seraphic (13/8), Mariole (7/2), Mister Des Places (4/1), Henrysbrotherjack (5/1), Douglas Dc (6/1)
